title: Anthropic transport thinking replay omits signature field, rejected by OpenRouter's strict validator
wanted_capability: OpenRouter serves the Anthropic Messages API natively (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/messages), which makes it a viable back end for the existing Anthropic-transport dispatch lanes via a brofile account env override (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL + ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN), unlocking provider-pinned fast-silicon workers (MiniMax M2.7 on Groq/SambaNova at 280-365 tok/s vs 11-34 tok/s on the current GLM lanes). The first live dispatch fails on turn 2: crates/bro-harness/src/transport/anthropic.rs (~461) replays the prior assistant thinking block but attaches signature only when the stream provided a non-empty signature_delta. OpenRouter's request validator requires signature as a string on replayed thinking blocks (its own responses carry signature: ""), so the continuation 400s with invalid_union at messages[N].content[0].signature. Wanted: replay thinking blocks with a signature field always present (empty string when the stream gave none), or an equivalent compatibility knob, after verifying the first-party lanes (Z.AI, MiniMax, Kimi, DeepSeek) tolerate signature: "".
missing_primitive: OpenRouter-compatible thinking-block replay on the bro-harness anthropic transport
fallback_used: None yet; the mm-samba brofile (minimax provider + openrouter account env) is parked on this failure.
evidence: task dc322d0b-1a3d-4feb-9440-deedbd1e775c (session 921ab674): anthropic messages 400 invalid_union at messages[2].content[0].signature, 2026-08-20
